channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of tech opinions and blog posts

item.title: Andrew Ng: AI chatbots are horrible for learning
item.description: Homework scores up, closed-book exam scores down 17% in the Wharton/UPenn study Ng cited — he says answer-giving chatbots cause cognitive offloading, and education needs tutor-style tools, not chatbots.

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: AI #191 — The Hackening Begins
item.description: Zvi frames the leaked PHP RCE plus a cluster of other incidents as the floodgates opening — “probably the worst day in cybersecurity history, so far” — alongside a run of agent misalignment incidents.

item.title: Dario Amodei replies to Encode's Nathan Calvin: Anthropic's 'race to the top'
item.description: In a ~2,000-word reply on Oct 21, Amodei defends staying at the frontier as the safety strategy, concedes three mistakes, and reveals Mythos-class models were held back Feb–June for cyber safeguards.
